name: Deck of Momentary Relief
body:
Aura: Moderate illusion; CL: Varies; Slot: None; Price: Varies by bonus (8,000 gp for a +1 deck, 32,000 gp for a +2 deck, 72,000 gp for a +3 deck, 128,000 gp for a +4 deck, 200,000 gp for a +5 deck, 288,000 gp for a +6 deck); Weight: –

DESCRIPTION

The fool on this deck’s card looks calm, even as he is continually running from unimaginable dangers. The deck provides an enhancement bonus of +1 to +6 on attack and damage rolls with jester spells and ranged attacks with its cards. On a critical hit, it deals an extra 1d10 points of damage per plus. Once per day, you can roll a d20 to determine the effect: Even: You are invisible (as per spell) until the end of your next turn.

Odd: You heal 1d4 (+ the deck’s bonus) hit points per level.
